answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the pearl of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The plume is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the echo. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
